<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Yellow blob - think, walk, salute</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin:0; padding:0; width:240px; height:240px; overflow:hidden; background:#ecd9a0; }
  canvas { display:block; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:240px; height:240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const PERIOD = 5990;
const V3 = THREE.Vector3;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf3e0a6);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xf8e6ae, 3, 14);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(44, 1, 0.1, 60);
camera.position.set(0, 0.85, 4);
camera.lookAt(0, 0.85, 0);

/* ---------------- lights ---------------- */
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff6dc, 0xd8b880, 1.7));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xfff0d0, 0.7));
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfffaf0, 1.5); fill.position.set(-1.5, 2.5, 6); scene.add(fill);
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffd68a, 2.0); sun.position.set(2.5, 3.2, -4); scene.add(sun);
const sideA = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe2b0, 0.7); sideA.position.set(-5, 2, 0); scene.add(sideA);
const sideB = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe2b0, 0.5); sideB.position.set(5, 1.5, 1); scene.add(sideB);

/* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
const lam = c => new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: c });
const bas = (c, o) => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial(Object.assign({ color: c }, o || {}));
function put(parent, geo, mat, x, y, z) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); m.position.set(x, y, z); parent.add(m); return m;
}
const box = (w, h, d) => new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d);
const cyl = (rt, rb, h, s) => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, s || 12);
const unitSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16);
const lowSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8);
const UP = new V3(0, 1, 0);
function stick(parent, a, b, r, mat) {
  const d = new V3().subVectors(b, a); const len = d.length();
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, len, 6), mat);
  m.position.copy(a).addScaledVector(d, 0.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UP, d.normalize());
  parent.add(m); return m;
}
function canvasTex(w, h, draw) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
  draw(c.getContext('2d'), w, h);
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace; return t;
}
function rng(seed) {
  return function () {
    seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/* ---------------- room ---------------- */
const room = new THREE.Group(); room.name = 'room'; scene.add(room);

put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(14, 12), lam(0xc9ac74), 0, 0, 0).rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.4, 2.7), lam(0xe9dab6), 0.95, 0.01, 1.3).rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;

const winTex = canvasTex(64, 64, (g, w, h) => {
  const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  lg.addColorStop(0, '#fff3c2'); lg.addColorStop(0.6, '#ffeeb6'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#f2dc9e');
  g.fillStyle = lg; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(214,196,140,0.75)';
  const b = [[1, 30, 6], [8, 36, 5], [14, 27, 6], [21, 34, 4], [26, 30, 6], [33, 38, 5], [39, 29, 6], [46, 35, 6], [53, 31, 5], [59, 37, 5]];
  for (const [x, y, bw] of b) g.fillRect(x, y, bw, h - y);
  g.fillStyle = 'rgba(176,172,104,0.6)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.arc(3 + i * 6.2, 51 + (i % 3) * 2, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill(); }
  const rg = g.createRadialGradient(24, 15, 0, 24, 15, 24);
  rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,246,1)'); rg.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,250,216,0.8)'); rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,180,0)');
  g.fillStyle = rg; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
});

const wallMat = bas(0xdccb92);
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.4, 3.4), wallMat, -3.3, 1.7, -3);
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.6, 0.5), wallMat, 2.2, 0.25, -3);
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.6, 0.1), wallMat, 2.2, 3.35, -3);
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.6, 2.8), bas(0xffffff, { map: winTex, fog: false }), 2.2, 1.9, -3);
put(room, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(14, 5), bas(0xd2bd84), 0, 3.4, -0.5).rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;

const mulMat = bas(0xd9c084);
for (const x of [-0.6, 0.35, 1.25, 2.15, 3.05]) put(room, box(0.07, 2.8, 0.06), mulMat, x, 1.9, -2.96);
put(room, box(5.6, 0.05, 0.06), mulMat, 2.2, 1.08, -2.96);
put(room, box(5.6, 0.08, 0.08), mulMat, 2.2, 3.28, -2.96);
put(room, box(5.6, 0.1, 0.12), bas(0xcdb47c), 2.2, 0.5, -2.94);
put(room, box(0.34, 2.9, 0.08), lam(0xf4e8c4), -0.74, 1.9, -2.88);

// mirror
{
  const mirror = new THREE.Group(); mirror.name = 'mirror'; mirror.position.set(-2.0, 2.5, -2.98);
  const circ = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 28);
  put(mirror, circ, bas(0xa9853c), 0, 0, 0).scale.set(0.29, 0.64, 1);
  put(mirror, circ, bas(0xe5e4c6), 0, 0, 0.01).scale.set(0.235, 0.585, 1);
  put(mirror, circ, bas(0xf5f1d8), 0.03, 0.1, 0.02).scale.set(0.12, 0.3, 1);
  room.add(mirror);
}

// bookshelf, console, small lamp
put(room, box(0.55, 2.4, 0.4), lam(0x8d6539), -2.8, 1.2, -2.7);
put(room, box(0.45, 0.3, 0.05), lam(0xc98a52), -2.8, 0.7, -2.48);
put(room, box(0.45, 0.3, 0.05), lam(0x9aa06a), -2.8, 1.3, -2.48);
put(room, box(0.45, 0.3, 0.05), lam(0xd9b27a), -2.8, 1.9, -2.48);
put(room, box(1.3, 0.72, 0.4), lam(0xa57c4a), -1.95, 0.36, -0.9);
put(room, cyl(0.09, 0.15, 0.2, 14), bas(0xfff4d2), -1.75, 1.05, -0.9);
put(room, cyl(0.015, 0.015, 0.24, 6), lam(0x8a6a3a), -1.75, 0.84, -0.9);
put(room, cyl(0.06, 0.07, 0.03, 10), lam(0x8a6a3a), -1.75, 0.735, -0.9);
put(room, box(0.3, 0.08, 0.2), lam(0xc7774a), -2.2, 0.76, -0.9);

// sofa
{
  const sofa = new THREE.Group(); sofa.name = 'sofa';
  const sofaMat = lam(0xecdcb6);
  put(sofa, new RoundedBoxGeometry(2.6, 0.5, 0.34, 3, 0.12), sofaMat, -1.45, 0.34, 0.55);
  put(sofa, new RoundedBoxGeometry(2.6, 0.28, 1.15, 3, 0.1), sofaMat, -1.45, 0.10, 1.1);
  put(sofa, new RoundedBoxGeometry(0.3, 0.44, 1.2, 3, 0.12), sofaMat, -0.22, 0.22, 1.08);
  const pl = [[-0.85, 0.42, 0.80, 0xe2a678, 0.15], [-0.5, 0.40, 0.82, 0xf4ead0, -0.2], [-1.3, 0.42, 0.80, 0xe9c39a, 0.1], [-1.8, 0.41, 0.80, 0xf1e4c4, -0.1]];
  for (const [x, y, z, c, rz] of pl) {
    const p = put(sofa, unitSphere, lam(c), x, y, z); p.scale.set(0.17, 0.17, 0.09); p.rotation.set(-0.3, 0, rz);
  }
  const stripeTex = canvasTex(16, 16, g => {
    g.fillStyle = '#f1e3bf'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16);
    g.fillStyle = '#cfa46a'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 3, 16);
    g.fillStyle = '#dcbd8c'; g.fillRect(8, 0, 2, 16);
  });
  stripeTex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping; stripeTex.repeat.set(4, 1);
  const blanket = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: stripeTex });
  put(sofa, box(0.62, 0.03, 0.75), blanket, -0.85, 0.255, 1.32);
  put(sofa, box(0.62, 0.3, 0.03), blanket, -0.85, 0.11, 1.70);
  sofa.position.x = 0.15;
  room.add(sofa);
}

// dining table
{
  const table = new THREE.Group(); table.name = 'dining-table'; table.position.set(0.03, 0, -1.5);
  put(table, box(1.7, 0.6, 0.95), lam(0xd8925f), 0, 0.52, 0);
  put(table, box(1.74, 0.03, 0.99), lam(0xf4d2a2), 0, 0.83, 0);
  put(table, box(1.71, 0.05, 0.96), lam(0xbf7850), 0, 0.27, 0);
  const legM = lam(0x7a5530);
  for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const sz of [-1, 1]) put(table, cyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.24, 8), legM, sx * 0.75, 0.12, sz * 0.38);
  put(table, cyl(0.05, 0.07, 0.2, 10), lam(0xf3ecd6), 0.27, 0.945, 0);
  const fl = [[0.27, 1.14, 0, 0x5c7f35, 0.09], [0.21, 1.2, 0.03, 0xb5442e, 0.06], [0.33, 1.22, -0.02, 0xd9772f, 0.06],
    [0.27, 1.28, 0.02, 0xa63a2a, 0.055], [0.2, 1.11, -0.03, 0x4c6f30, 0.06], [0.35, 1.13, 0.03, 0x6a8a3a, 0.06], [0.3, 1.19, 0.06, 0xe8c04a, 0.045]];
  for (const [x, y, z, c, r] of fl) put(table, lowSphere, lam(c), x, y, z).scale.setScalar(r);
  const china = lam(0xfaf4e2);
  put(table, cyl(0.04, 0.03, 0.07, 10), china, -0.38, 0.88, 0.2);
  put(table, cyl(0.04, 0.03, 0.07, 10), china, -0.05, 0.88, 0.28);
  put(table, cyl(0.1, 0.06, 0.05, 12), china, -0.55, 0.87, -0.12);
  put(table, cyl(0.11, 0.11, 0.012, 14), china, 0.55, 0.852, 0.2);
  room.add(table);
}

// chairs
{
  const wood = lam(0x8f5f33), weave = lam(0xcfa66c);
  const makeChair = (x, z, ry) => {
    const c = new THREE.Group(); c.name = 'chair';
    put(c, box(0.42, 0.04, 0.42), weave, 0, 0.45, 0);
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) for (const sz of [-1, 1]) put(c, box(0.04, 0.45, 0.04), wood, sx * 0.19, 0.225, sz * 0.19);
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) put(c, box(0.04, 0.52, 0.04), wood, sx * 0.19, 0.70, -0.19);
    put(c, box(0.40, 0.07, 0.03), wood, 0, 0.90, -0.19);
    put(c, box(0.40, 0.05, 0.03), wood, 0, 0.72, -0.19);
    c.position.set(x, 0, z); c.rotation.y = ry; room.add(c); return c;
  };
  makeChair(1.0, -0.75, -Math.PI / 2 + 0.25);
  makeChair(-0.6, -0.75, Math.PI + 0.15);
  makeChair(0.38, -0.68, Math.PI - 0.2);
  makeChair(-0.3, -2.25, 0.1);
}

// pendant lamp
{
  const lamp = new THREE.Group(); lamp.name = 'pendant-lamp'; lamp.position.set(0, 2.03, -1);
  const rattanTex = canvasTex(16, 16, g => {
    g.fillStyle = '#c28f4c'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16);
    g.fillStyle = '#a06d30'; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i += 4) g.fillRect(0, i, 16, 1.5);
    g.fillStyle = '#b07c3c'; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i += 4) g.fillRect(i, 0, 1, 16);
  });
  rattanTex.wrapS = rattanTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; rattanTex.repeat.set(6, 2);
  const shade = put(lamp, new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.34, 20, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
    new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: rattanTex, side: THREE.DoubleSide, emissive: 0x4a2c08 }), 0, 0, 0);
  shade.scale.y = 1.3;
  put(lamp, new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.34, 0.016, 6, 24), lam(0x8f6330), 0, 0, 0).rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  put(lamp, unitSphere, bas(0xfff0b8), 0, 0.1, 0).scale.setScalar(0.09);
  put(lamp, cyl(0.01, 0.01, 0.93, 6), lam(0x6b4a2a), 0, 0.906, 0);
  room.add(lamp);
}

// plants
{
  const plantL = new THREE.Group(); plantL.name = 'plant-left'; plantL.position.set(-0.95, 0, -2.3);
  put(plantL, cyl(0.2, 0.15, 0.36, 12), lam(0xb98a58), 0, 0.18, 0);
  stick(plantL, new V3(0, 0.3, 0), new V3(0.03, 1.9, 0), 0.03, lam(0x7a5a34));
  const gl = [lam(0x6f9a3e), lam(0x86ad4a), lam(0x587f38), lam(0x7da544)];
  const r1 = rng(11);
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const a = r1() * 6.283, rad = 0.08 + r1() * 0.32, y = 1.2 + r1() * 1.4;
    const m = put(plantL, lowSphere, gl[i % 4], Math.cos(a) * rad, y, Math.sin(a) * rad);
    m.scale.set(0.2, 0.045, 0.11);
    m.rotation.set((r1() - 0.5) * 1.0, -a, (r1() - 0.5) * 1.2);
  }
  room.add(plantL);

  const plantR = new THREE.Group(); plantR.name = 'plant-right'; plantR.position.set(1.85, 0, -1.0);
  put(plantR, cyl(0.17, 0.2, 0.45, 12), lam(0x8c6238), 0, 0.225, 0);
  put(plantR, cyl(0.25, 0.19, 0.4, 14), lam(0xb5855a), 0, 0.65, 0);
  const gr = [lam(0x3c6b33), lam(0x2f5a2c), lam(0x4d7d3a)];
  const stemM = lam(0x4a6a30);
  const r2 = rng(5);
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = r2() * 6.283, rad = 0.1 + r2() * 0.32, y = 1.05 + r2() * 1.05;
    const p = new V3(Math.cos(a) * rad, y, Math.sin(a) * rad);
    stick(plantR, new V3(0, 0.8, 0), p, 0.012, stemM);
    const m = put(plantR, lowSphere, gr[i % 3], p.x, p.y, p.z);
    m.scale.set(0.26, 0.035, 0.19);
    m.rotation.set((r2() - 0.5) * 1.2, -a, (r2() - 0.5) * 1.0);
  }
  room.add(plantR);
}

// sun rays + glare
{
  const A = new V3(1.444, 2.516, -2.6);
  const pos = [], col = [];
  const rays = [[205, 5, 3.6, 0.22], [221, 4, 3.3, 0.18], [238, 5, 3.0, 0.2], [190, 3, 3.2, 0.12]];
  for (const [deg, hw, len, br] of rays) {
    const a0 = (deg - hw) * Math.PI / 180, a1 = (deg + hw) * Math.PI / 180;
    pos.push(A.x, A.y, A.z,
      A.x + Math.cos(a0) * len, A.y + Math.sin(a0) * len, A.z,
      A.x + Math.cos(a1) * len, A.y + Math.sin(a1) * len, A.z);
    col.push(br, br * 0.93, br * 0.7, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(g, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    vertexColors: true, transparent: true, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
    depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, fog: false
  }));
  m.name = 'sun-rays'; room.add(m);

  const glowTex = canvasTex(64, 64, gg => {
    const rg = gg.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
    rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,253,235,1)');
    rg.addColorStop(0.12, 'rgba(255,248,210,0.85)');
    rg.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,238,175,0.32)');
    rg.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(255,232,160,0.08)');
    rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,230,150,0)');
    gg.fillStyle = rg; gg.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  });
  const glare = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
    map: glowTex, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, transparent: true, fog: false
  }));
  glare.name = 'sun-glare';
  glare.position.set(0.985, 1.986, -0.5); glare.scale.set(2.1, 2.1, 1);
  room.add(glare);
}

/* ---------------- character ---------------- */
const cm = (c, r, extra) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(Object.assign({ color: c, roughness: r, metalness: 0, fog: false }, extra || {}));
const matYellow = cm(0xf5cf2a, 0.55);
const matBelly = cm(0xf7f1dc, 0.7);
const matHand = cm(0x4f7088, 0.6);
const matLid = cm(0xe9bd20, 0.6, { side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const matWhite = cm(0xfbf8ea, 0.35);
const matIris = cm(0x6aa62c, 0.4);
const matPupil = cm(0x17170f, 0.3);
const matGlint = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, fog: false });
const matMouth = cm(0x6b4310, 0.8);

const CHAR_SCALE = 0.95;
const CHAR_Z = 2.12;

const character = new THREE.Group(); character.name = 'character-yellow-blob';
character.rotation.order = 'ZYX';
character.scale.setScalar(CHAR_SCALE);
scene.add(character);
const body = new THREE.Group(); body.name = 'body'; character.add(body);

// torso (lathe)
{
  const prof = [[0, 0], [0.2, 0], [0.32, 0.035], [0.37, 0.13], [0.39, 0.27], [0.39, 0.42], [0.375, 0.58],
    [0.345, 0.72], [0.30, 0.84], [0.245, 0.94], [0.20, 1.02], [0.165, 1.10], [0.10, 1.17], [0, 1.19]];
  const sc = new THREE.SplineCurve(prof.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1])));
  const lp = sc.getPoints(70).map(p => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, p.x), Math.max(0, p.y)));
  lp[0].set(0, 0); lp[lp.length - 1].set(0, 1.19);
  const torso = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(lp, 36), matYellow);
  torso.name = 'torso'; body.add(torso);
  const belly = put(body, unitSphere, matBelly, 0, 0.48, 0.14); belly.name = 'belly';
  belly.scale.set(0.29, 0.50, 0.29);
}

// head
const head = new THREE.Group(); head.name = 'head'; head.position.set(0, 1.0, 0); body.add(head);
put(head, unitSphere, matYellow, 0, 0.14, 0).scale.set(0.18, 0.24, 0.19);
put(head, unitSphere, matYellow, 0, 0.09, 0.105).scale.set(0.125, 0.085, 0.1);

const eyes = new THREE.Group(); eyes.name = 'eyes'; head.add(eyes);
const lidGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2);
const lids = [];
function makeEye(side) {
  const e = new THREE.Group(); e.name = side > 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right';
  e.position.set(0.072 * side, 0.19, 0.142);
  e.rotation.set(-0.04, 0.24 * side, 0);
  put(e, unitSphere, matWhite, 0, 0, 0).scale.setScalar(0.048);
  put(e, unitSphere, matIris, 0, 0, 0.040).scale.set(0.032, 0.032, 0.012);
  put(e, unitSphere, matPupil, 0, 0, 0.049).scale.set(0.017, 0.017, 0.008);
  put(e, unitSphere, matGlint, 0.011, 0.013, 0.054).scale.setScalar(0.006);
  const lid = new THREE.Group(); lid.name = 'eyelid';
  put(lid, lidGeo, matLid, 0, 0, 0).scale.setScalar(0.060);
  e.add(lid); lids.push(lid);
  eyes.add(e);
}
makeEye(1); makeEye(-1);

const mouth = new THREE.Group(); mouth.name = 'mouth'; mouth.position.set(0, 0.125, 0.203); head.add(mouth);
{
  const mm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.055, 0.008, 6, 14, 2.0), matMouth);
  mm.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 2 - 1.0; mouth.add(mm);
}

// arms
const L1 = 0.36, L2 = 0.34;
function makeArm(side) {
  const arm = new THREE.Group(); arm.name = side > 0 ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  arm.position.set(0.30 * side, 0.80, 0.05);
  const upper = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, L1, 6, 14), matYellow);
  upper.position.y = -L1 / 2; arm.add(upper);
  const forearm = new THREE.Group(); forearm.name = 'forearm'; forearm.position.y = -L1; arm.add(forearm);
  const fore = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.088, L2, 6, 14), matYellow);
  fore.position.y = -L2 / 2; forearm.add(fore);
  const hand = new THREE.Group(); hand.name = side > 0 ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right'; hand.position.y = -L2; forearm.add(hand);
  put(hand, unitSphere, matHand, 0, -0.075, 0).scale.set(0.055, 0.125, 0.09);
  put(hand, unitSphere, matHand, 0, -0.03, 0.08).scale.set(0.035, 0.05, 0.04);
  arm.userData.forearm = forearm;
  arm.userData.hand = hand;
  body.add(arm);
  return arm;
}
const armL = makeArm(1), armR = makeArm(-1);

// feet
for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
  const f = new THREE.Group(); f.name = s > 0 ? 'foot-left' : 'foot-right';
  f.position.set(0.17 * s, 0.045, 0.27); f.rotation.y = 0.25 * s;
  put(f, unitSphere, matHand, 0, 0, 0).scale.set(0.12, 0.05, 0.17);
  character.add(f);
}

// soft ground shadow
const shadow = put(scene, new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.5, 24),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x6b4a1c, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, depthWrite: false }), 0, 0.02, 0);
shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; shadow.name = 'ground-shadow';
shadow.scale.setScalar(CHAR_SCALE);

/* ---------------- two-bone IK with optional wrist bend ---------------- */
const DOWN = new V3(0, -1, 0);
const _d = new V3(), _dir = new V3(), _p = new V3(), _E = new V3(), _u = new V3(), _f = new V3(), _T = new V3(), _hd = new V3();
const _q1 = new THREE.Quaternion(), _q2 = new THREE.Quaternion(), _q3 = new THREE.Quaternion(), _q4 = new THREE.Quaternion();
function solveArm(arm, T, hint, hdir, k) {
  const S = arm.position;
  _d.subVectors(T, S);
  let dist = _d.length();
  if (dist < 1e-5) { _d.set(0, -1, 0); dist = 1; }
  _dir.copy(_d).divideScalar(dist);
  dist = Math.min(Math.max(dist, 0.1), L1 + L2 - 0.004);
  const a = (L1 * L1 - L2 * L2 + dist * dist) / (2 * dist);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, L1 * L1 - a * a));
  _p.copy(hint).addScaledVector(_dir, -hint.dot(_dir));
  if (_p.lengthSq() < 1e-8) _p.set(1, 0, 0);
  _p.normalize();
  _E.copy(_dir).multiplyScalar(a).addScaledVector(_p, h);
  _u.copy(_E).normalize();
  _T.copy(_dir).multiplyScalar(dist);
  _f.subVectors(_T, _E).normalize();
  _q1.setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, _u);
  _q2.setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, _f);
  arm.quaternion.copy(_q1);
  arm.userData.forearm.quaternion.copy(_q1).invert().multiply(_q2);
  const hand = arm.userData.hand;
  hand.quaternion.identity();
  if (k > 1e-4 && hdir.lengthSq() > 1e-8) {
    _hd.copy(hdir).normalize();
    _q3.setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, _hd);
    _q4.copy(_q2).invert().multiply(_q3);
    hand.quaternion.slerp(_q4, Math.min(1, k));
  }
}

/* ---------------- animation ---------------- */
// keyframe times of the GIF; the last entry closes the loop (the GIF hard-cuts back to frame 1)
const KT = [0, 870, 1670, 2530, 3400, 4270, 5070, 5930, 5990];
const K = {
  x:      [-0.54, -0.43, 0.0, 0.47, 0.94, 0.95, 0.35, 0.032, 0.02],
  y:      [0.008, 0.032, 0.021, -0.013, -0.07, -0.02, 0.045, 0.037, 0.037],
  yaw:    [-0.10, -0.05, -0.25, -0.35, -0.30, 0.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.10],
  lean:   [0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -0.03, -0.10, -0.17, 0.0, 0.01],
  sal:    [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.1, 0.6, 1, 2, 2],          // right arm: 0 chin, 1 raised, 2 full salute
  drop:   [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.15, 0.7, 1, 1, 1],         // left arm: 0 across belly, 1 hanging
  lid:    [0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, -0.2, -0.8, -0.85, -0.85, -0.85],
  hyaw:   [-0.05, -0.05, 0.15, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 0.10, 0.0, 0.0],
  hpitch: [0.05, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.05, 0.0, -0.03, 0.0, 0.0]
};
function slope(v, i) {
  const n = KT.length;
  if (i === 0) return (v[1] - v[0]) / (KT[1] - KT[0]);
  if (i === n - 1) return (v[n - 1] - v[n - 2]) / (KT[n - 1] - KT[n - 2]);
  return (v[i + 1] - v[i - 1]) / (KT[i + 1] - KT[i - 1]);
}
function samp(v, t) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < KT.length - 2 && t >= KT[i + 1]) i++;
  const t0 = KT[i], t1 = KT[i + 1], h = t1 - t0;
  const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - t0) / h));
  const m0 = slope(v, i) * h, m1 = slope(v, i + 1) * h;
  const u2 = u * u, u3 = u2 * u;
  return (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * v[i] + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m0 + (-2 * u3 + 3 * u2) * v[i + 1] + (u3 - u2) * m1;
}
const clamp01 = v => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v));
const smooth = u => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);

// arm targets in body space (character faces +Z)
const RT0 = new V3(-0.11, 0.96, 0.30), RH0 = new V3(0, -1, 1);                                      // right hand at chin
const RT1 = new V3(-0.245, 1.31, 0.15), RH1 = new V3(-1, 0.5, 0.8), RD1 = new V3(0.97, 0.15, 0.10); // raised to forehead
const RT2 = new V3(-0.27, 1.27, 0.15), RH2 = new V3(-1, 0.3, 0.2), RD2 = new V3(0.95, 0.25, 0.10);  // full salute, elbow out
const LT0 = new V3(0.05, 0.52, 0.50), LH0 = new V3(1, -0.3, 1.0), LD0 = new V3(-0.9, 0.15, -0.1);   // left arm across belly
const LT1 = new V3(0.38, 0.24, -0.22), LH1 = new V3(0.7, 0, -0.8);                                  // left arm hanging
const tR = new V3(), hR = new V3(), dR = new V3(), tL = new V3(), hL = new V3();

function pose(t) {
  const tt = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
  const x = samp(K.x, tt), y = samp(K.y, tt);
  const yaw = samp(K.yaw, tt);
  let lean = samp(K.lean, tt);
  const s = Math.min(2, Math.max(0, samp(K.sal, tt)));
  const w = clamp01(samp(K.drop, tt));
  const lid = samp(K.lid, tt);

  const ph = tt / PERIOD * Math.PI * 2 * 14;
  const bob = Math.sin(ph) * 0.012;
  lean += Math.sin(ph * 0.5) * 0.012;

  character.position.set(x, 0, CHAR_Z);
  character.rotation.set(0, yaw, lean);

  const sy = 1 + (y + bob) / 1.38;
  const sxz = 1 / Math.sqrt(sy);
  body.scale.set(sxz, sy, sxz);

  head.rotation.set(samp(K.hpitch, tt), samp(K.hyaw, tt), Math.sin(ph * 0.5) * 0.02);
  for (const l of lids) l.rotation.x = lid;

  // mouth: small smirk while thinking, full smile when saluting
  const happy = clamp01(s);
  mouth.scale.set(0.8 + 0.2 * happy, 0.6 + 0.4 * happy, 1);
  mouth.position.y = 0.125 - 0.022 * (1 - happy);

  // right arm: chin -> raised -> salute
  let kR;
  if (s <= 1) {
    tR.lerpVectors(RT0, RT1, s); hR.lerpVectors(RH0, RH1, s); dR.copy(RD1);
    kR = smooth(clamp01((s - 0.3) / 0.6));
  } else {
    const v = s - 1;
    tR.lerpVectors(RT1, RT2, v); hR.lerpVectors(RH1, RH2, v); dR.lerpVectors(RD1, RD2, v);
    kR = 1;
  }
  solveArm(armR, tR, hR, dR, kR);

  // left arm: across belly -> hanging, kept outside the body
  tL.lerpVectors(LT0, LT1, w); hL.lerpVectors(LH0, LH1, w);
  const rr = Math.hypot(tL.x, tL.z);
  const rmin = 0.44 + 0.06 * clamp01(tL.z / Math.max(rr, 1e-4));
  if (rr < rmin) { const k2 = rmin / Math.max(rr, 1e-4); tL.x *= k2; tL.z *= k2; }
  const kL = 1 - smooth(clamp01(w / 0.6));
  solveArm(armL, tL, hL, LD0, kL);

  shadow.position.set(x, 0.02, CHAR_Z);
}

function render(t) {
  pose(Number(t) || 0);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
